title: Google changes which Gemini models personal accounts can access
friendlyTitle: Free and paid Gemini users will get different models
summary: From October 9, personal Gemini users without a paid plan will have Flash-Lite but not Flash or Pro; AI Plus adds Flash, while AI Pro and Ultra retain all three. Available models also gain low, medium and high effort settings, with higher effort consuming more of a user’s allowance.
friendlySummary: Google is changing Gemini access from October 9. Free users get Flash-Lite, while higher paid plans unlock Flash, Pro and stronger reasoning options.
whyItMatters: People who rely on a particular Gemini model for routine work may see its availability change even though the app remains the same. Check the model shown in the interface, and compare the cost of a plan with the value of the workflows that need the more capable tiers.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Your usual Gemini results may change if the app moves you to another model. Check which model you have before paying or changing an important workflow.
